ns2:course.label: Contemporary Nutrition
ns2:course.description: Fundamental principles of human nutrition and their application to the selection of an adequate diet for health and wellness; current nutrition topics of importance. Credit is not given for FSHN 120 if credit has been given for FSHN 220. Prerequisite: CHEM 101 or equivalent.
